name: kickoff-plan
title: Kickoff plan
for_each: select id,name from onboarding.projects order by name

sections.title: Milestones
sections.sql: select name,due_on from onboarding.milestones where project_id=$1

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.sql: select name,owner,responsible,due_on from onboarding.tasks where project_id=$1

name: acceptance-record
title: Acceptance record
for_each: select id,name from onboarding.projects order by name

sections.title: Readiness
sections.sql: select name,status,open_tasks,unaccepted,ready from onboarding.launch_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Customer acceptance
sections.sql: select name,accepted_by,accepted_on,evidence from onboarding.milestones where project_id=$1

sections.title: Completion evidence
sections.sql: select name,status,evidence,completed_on from onboarding.tasks where project_id=$1

name: handover-pack
title: Handover pack
for_each: select id,name from onboarding.projects order by name

sections.title: Launch record
sections.sql: select name,status,launched_on,launch_evidence from onboarding.projects where id=$1

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.sql: select name,accepted_by,accepted_on,evidence from onboarding.milestones where project_id=$1

sections.title: Work history
sections.sql: select name,actor,logged_on,hours from onboarding.updates where project_id=$1 order by logged_on
